title: Imvelo nezinkathi zonyaka
description: Ten short, simple stories about nature and the seasons: firewood on a cold June day in Bergville, a cane rat in the February maize, a lorry in a March storm, a competition of indigenous flowers, the winter stars over Mpendle, a drought in Mahlabathini, a hot December family feast in Durban, an old smoker who falls ill in winter, a wild young horse that grows tame, and a schoolgirl who studies the clay by an old fort in autumn.

lessons.title: Izinkuni zangoJuni
lessons.summary: On a cold, cloudy June day in Bergville, grandmother Nomagugu, with the baby on her back, takes her grandson Sakhumzi to fetch firewood among the bare trees; she makes him wear shoes, they hurry home before dark and warm themselves at the fire.
lessons.text:
UNomagugu ungugogo omdala. Uhlala eBergville nomzukulu wakhe, uSakhumzi, nengane encane. NgoJuni kuyabanda kakhulu eBergville. Izihlahla zimi ze. Amafu amnyama amboza ilanga izinsuku eziningi.

Ngolunye usuku ekuseni uNomagugu uthi: "Sakhumzi, kuyabanda endlini. Asinazo izinkuni. Masihambe siyothatha izinkuni ehlathini."

USakhumzi uyaphuma. Akafaki izicathulo. Ufuna ukuhamba ngezinyawo ze. Ugogo uthi: "Cha, Sakhumzi! Ungahambi ngezinyawo ze. NgoJuni umhlabathi ubanda kakhulu. Faka izicathulo zakho." USakhumzi ubuyela endlini. Ufaka izicathulo zakhe ezindala.

UNomagugu ubeletha ingane encane. Ingane ilala emhlane kagogo. Bahamba ndawonye baya ehlathini. Ehlathini izihlahla nazo zimi ze. USakhumzi uthatha ukhuni ngokhuni. Ugogo ubeletha ingane, kodwa naye uthatha izinkuni ezincane. Babopha izinkuni ngentambo.

Amafu amboza izulu lonke. Umoya uyabanda kakhulu. Ugogo uthi: "Shesha, Sakhumzi. NgoJuni kuhlwa ngokushesha." USakhumzi uthwala izinkuni. Ugogo ubeletha ingane. Babuyela ekhaya.

Bafika ekhaya. Kuyahlwa. Kusihlwa uSakhumzi wakha umlilo ngezinkuni. Umlilo uyavutha. Ugogo uthi: "Woza, mzukulu wami. Masothe umlilo." Bahlala eduze komlilo, bayotha. Ugogo uyotha umlilo, futhi ingane ilala emhlane wakhe. Bayajabula, ngoba ababandi manje.

Ugogo uthi: "Ngiyakubonga, Sakhumzi. Izinkuni zakho zisisiza kakhulu ngoJuni." USakhumzi uthi: "Gogo, kusasa ngizothatha izinkuni futhi. Kodwa ngeke ngihambe ngezinyawo ze."

Imibuzo:
NgoJuni kuyabanda eBergville na?
Kunjalo, ngoJuni kuyabanda kakhulu.
USakhumzi ufuna ukuhamba ngezinyawo ze na?
Kunjalo, kodwa ugogo uthi afake izicathulo zakhe.
Ugogo ubeletha ingane encane na?
Kunjalo, ingane ilala emhlane kagogo.
USakhumzi uthatha izinkuni ehlathini na?
Kunjalo, uthatha ukhuni ngokhuni.
Kusihlwa bayotha umlilo na?
Kunjalo, bahlala eduze komlilo, bayotha.

lessons.title: Ihlezi ensimini
lessons.summary: In February a cane rat digs a hole among farmer Bhekumuzi's rows of maize in Hluhluwe; he and his son Zolani lie in wait with sticks, Bhekumuzi falls over and the boy laughs, and they block the hole, harvest and grind the maize.
lessons.text:
UBhekumuzi ungumlimi eHluhluwe. Unensimu enkulu yommbila. Ummbila wakhe umi ngezinhla ezinde. Uhla ngalunye lude kakhulu. NgoFebruwari kuyashisa eHluhluwe, futhi ummbila uyakhula kahle.

Ngolunye usuku ngoFebruwari uBhekumuzi uhamba phakathi kwezinhla zommbila. Ubona into embi. Ohleni lwesithathu ezinye izitshalo zommbila ziwile phansi. Okuthile kudle ummbila wakhe. Eduze kwezitshalo kukhona umgodi omkhulu emhlabathini.

UBhekumuzi uyathukuthela. Ubiza indodana yakhe, uZolani. Uthi: "Zolani, buka! Isilwane sidla ummbila wami. Yisilwane sini lesi?" UZolani ubheka umgodi. Ubheka nommbila. Uthi: "Baba, yihlezi. Ihlezi liyawuthanda ummbila kakhulu. Lihlala emgodini." UBhekumuzi uthukuthela kakhulu. Uthi: "Ihlezi lidla ummbila wami! Kusihlwa sizolibamba."

Kusihlwa uBhekumuzi noZolani bathatha izinduku. UBhekumuzi unenduku ende, uZolani unenduku encane. Bahlala phakathi kwezinhla, eduze komgodi. Balinda isikhathi eside. Ekugcineni ihlezi liphuma emgodini. Likhulu, futhi linomzimba omkhulu. Lidla ummbila ohleni lwesithathu.

UBhekumuzi ugijima nenduku yakhe. Kodwa uyawa phakathi kommbila. UZolani uyahleka kakhulu. Ihlezi ligijima, lingena emgodini futhi. UBhekumuzi uthi: "Ungahleki, Zolani!" Kodwa ngemuva kwesikhashana naye uyahleka.

Ekuseni bavala umgodi ngamatshe. Ihlezi alibuyanga. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa bavuna ummbila. Bagaya ummbila ekhaya. Bagaya ummbila izinsuku ezimbili. Ummbila ogayiwe bawufaka ezikhwameni ezinkulu. UBhekumuzi uthi: "Ihlezi alizange lidle ummbila wonke. Kusekhona ummbila omningi." UZolani uyahleka futhi. Uthi: "Baba, ngeke ngikhohlwe ihlezi nenduku yakho."

Imibuzo:
UBhekumuzi unensimu yommbila na?
Kunjalo, ummbila wakhe umi ngezinhla ezinde.
UZolani uthi yisilwane sini?
Uthi yihlezi. Ihlezi lihlala emgodini.
UBhekumuzi uyathukuthela na?
Kunjalo, uthukuthela kakhulu.
UBhekumuzi uyawa phakathi kommbila na?
Kunjalo, uyawa, futhi uZolani uyahleka kakhulu.
Bagaya ummbila ngemuva kokuwuvuna na?
Kunjalo, bagaya ummbila ekhaya.

lessons.title: Iloli emvuleni
lessons.summary: Truck driver Ntombizodwa, warned by the police about a March storm from the west, finds the road to Harding washed away; she backs up, her wheels sink in a muddy hole, and the next day the government's workers repair the road.
lessons.text:
UNtombizodwa ushayela iloli elikhulu. Uhlala eThekwini. Unelayisense lokushayela amaloli amakhulu. NgoMashi ushayela iloli lakhe esuka eThekwini eya eHarding. Iloli ligcwele ukudla kwezitolo.

Emgwaqweni kukhona amaphoyisa. Iphoyisa lithi iloli lime. Iloli liyama. Iphoyisa lithi: "Ngicela ilayisense lakho." UNtombizodwa ukhipha ilayisense lakhe. Iphoyisa libheka ilayisense, bese lithi: "Kulungile. Kodwa ngiyakuxwayisa. Imvula enkulu ivela entshonalanga. NgoMashi imvula enjalo iyafika kaningi."

UNtombizodwa uyaqhubeka. Ubheka entshonalanga. Amafu amnyama avela entshonalanga. Ngemuva kwesikhashana imvula enkulu iyana. Iloli lihamba kancane.

Eduze neHarding kukhona umfula. Amanzi omfula maningi kakhulu. Imvula ilimaze ingqalasizinda yendawo: imigwaqo nezintambo zikagesi. Indoda yendawo ime emgwaqweni. Iyamxwayisa: "Ungaqhubeki! Phambili awusekho umgwaqo. Amanzi awuthathile."

UNtombizodwa uyezwa. Kufuneka ahlehle. Iloli lihlehla kancane. Kodwa amasondo angemuva angena emgodini onamanzi. Amasondo ayazungeza, kodwa iloli alihambi. Ukukhathazeka kukaNtombizodwa kukhulu. Uthi: "Ukudla kwezitolo kufuneka kufike namuhla!"

Indoda ibiza abangane bayo. Amadoda amane afika. Bonke basiza ukukhipha iloli. Ekugcineni amasondo aphuma emgodini. Iloli liyahlehla, lime endaweni ephephile.

Kufuneka uNtombizodwa alinde. Ulala elolini. Ekuseni uhulumeni uthumela abasebenzi. Abasebenzi balungisa ingqalasizinda: benza umgwaqo omusha omncane. UNtombizodwa uyaqhubeka, afike eHarding emini.

Owesifazane wesitolo uthi: "Ngiyajabula ukukubona. Ukukhathazeka kwami kuphelile manje." UNtombizodwa uthi: "Nami. Iphoyisa langixwayisa, futhi indoda yangixwayisa. Ngiyababonga."

Imibuzo:
UNtombizodwa unelayisense lokushayela amaloli na?
Kunjalo, unelayisense lokushayela amaloli amakhulu.
Imvula enkulu ivela entshonalanga na?
Kunjalo, amafu amnyama avela entshonalanga.
Imvula ilimaze ingqalasizinda na?
Kunjalo, ilimaze imigwaqo nezintambo zikagesi.
Amasondo angena emgodini na?
Kunjalo, amasondo angemuva angena emgodini onamanzi.
UNtombizodwa ufika eHarding ngosuku lokuqala na?
Cha, kufuneka alinde. Ufika ngosuku olulandelayo.

lessons.title: Izimbali zomdabu
lessons.summary: Nonjabulo of Newcastle enters her indigenous flowers in a free flower competition, with one red flower standing out among the white ones in a bottle; the judge Mncedisi praises their beauty and she wins, then gives her seeds away for free.
lessons.text:
UNonjabulo uhlala eNewcastle. Uthanda izimbali kakhulu. Ensimini yakhe utshala izimbali zomdabu. Izimbali zomdabu yizimbali ezikhula ezweni lethu kusukela kudala. Ziyathandeka, futhi azidingi amanzi amaningi.

Ngonyaka ngamunye eNewcastle kukhona umncintiswano wezimbali. Abantu abaningi bayancintisana. Ukungena kumahhala. Akukho mali edingekayo, ngoba umncintiswano umahhala. Ngonyaka odlule uNonjabulo akancintisananga. Kodwa kulo nyaka uthi: "Nami ngizoncintisana. Ngifuna abantu babone ubuhle bezimbali zomdabu."

UNonjabulo ukhetha izimbali zakhe ezinhle kakhulu. Uzifaka ebhodleleni elikhulu elinamanzi. Ibhodlela limhlophe. Phakathi kwezimbali ezimhlophe kukhona imbali enkulu ebomvu. Imbali ebomvu iyagqama.

Ngosuku lomncintiswano uNonjabulo uthatha ibhodlela lakhe, aye esikoleni esikhulu. Lapho kunabantu abaningi abancintisanayo. Abanye banezimbali ezivela ezitolo. Abanye banezimbali ezivela kwamanye amazwe. Zinhle, kodwa azizona izimbali zomdabu. UNonjabulo yedwa unezimbali zomdabu.

Ijaji lomncintiswano nguMncedisi. Ijaji libheka izimbali ngazinye. Ijaji libheka ubuhle bembali ngayinye. Ekugcineni ijaji lima eduze nebhodlela likaNonjabulo. Libheka izimbali isikhathi eside.

Ijaji lithi: "Ngiyazincoma lezi zimbali. Ubuhle bazo bukhulu. Imbali ebomvu iyagqama phakathi kwezimbali ezimhlophe. Futhi ziyizimbali zomdabu." UNonjabulo uyajabula. Uthi: "Ngiyakubonga. Izimbali zomdabu ziyathandeka kimi."

Ekugcineni ijaji lithi kubo bonke: "Umklomelo wokuqala uya kuNonjabulo!" Abantu bayamncoma uNonjabulo. Bathi: "Izimbali zakho ziyathandeka. Sicela usinike imbewu yazo." UNonjabulo uthi: "Kulungile. Ngizoninika imbewu mahhala." Unika abantu abaningi imbewu yezimbali zomdabu mahhala.

Imibuzo:
UNonjabulo utshala izimbali zomdabu na?
Kunjalo, utshala izimbali zomdabu ensimini yakhe.
Ukungena emncintiswaneni kumahhala na?
Kunjalo, ukungena kumahhala.
Imbali ebomvu iyagqama na?
Kunjalo, iyagqama phakathi kwezimbali ezimhlophe.
Ijaji liyazincoma izimbali zikaNonjabulo na?
Kunjalo, lithi ubuhle bazo bukhulu.
UNonjabulo uthola umklomelo wokuqala na?
Kunjalo, umklomelo wokuqala uya kuye.

lessons.title: Izinkanyezi zaseMpendle
lessons.summary: On a clear June night in Mpendle, Zwelethu translates a chapter of his daughter Nosisa's English book about the stars of the seasons and points the stars out to her; the next day she finds their pictures on the school computer.
lessons.text:
UZwelethu uhlala eMpendle nomfazi wakhe nendodakazi yabo, uNosisa. UNosisa uneminyaka eyishumi. Uthanda izinkanyezi kakhulu.

NgoJuni kuyabanda eMpendle, kodwa ebusuku akukho mafu. Umoya umsulwa. Akukho ntuthu, futhi akukho ukukhanya kwedolobha. Ngakho izinkanyezi ziyagqama ezulwini.

UNosisa unebhuku elisha elivela esikoleni. Ibhuku likhuluma ngezinkanyezi. Kodwa ibhuku libhalwe ngesiNgisi. UNosisa ufunda isiNgisi esikoleni, kodwa akasazi kahle. Akaziqondi kahle izinto ezibhalwe ebhukwini.

Unina uthi: "Buza uyihlo. Uyihlo uyasazi isiNgisi, futhi uyazazi izinkanyezi." UNosisa uya kuyise. Uthi: "Baba, ngicela ungihumushele lesi siqephu sebhuku." Isiqephu sesithathu sikhuluma ngezinkanyezi zezinkathi zonyaka.

Kusihlwa uZwelethu noNosisa baphuma ngaphandle. Umoya umsulwa futhi uyabanda. UZwelethu ufunda isiqephu ngesiNgisi, bese ehumusha ngesiZulu. Uthi: "Ibhuku lithi izinkanyezi ezithile zibonakala ebusika kuphela. Ezinye zibonakala ehlobo kuphela."

UZwelethu ukhomba ngomunwe. Uthi: "Buka lapha, Nosisa. Ngizokutshengisa izinkanyezi ezintathu ezisohleni olulodwa." UNosisa ubheka umunwe kayise. Ubona izinkanyezi ezintathu. Uthi: "Baba, ngiyazibona! Ngitshengise ezinye."

UZwelethu umtshengisa izinkanyezi eziningi. Uhumusha isiqephu sonke. UNosisa uyajabula. Uthi kunina: "Mama, ubaba uhlakaniphile!" Unina uyajabula. Uthi: "Yebo. Uyihlo uyazazi izinkanyezi kusukela kudala."

Ngakusasa uNosisa usebenzisa ikhompyutha yesikole. Ekhompyutheni ufuna izithombe zezinkanyezi. Uthola izithombe zezinkanyezi ezintathu. Uthi kumfundisi wakhe: "Ubaba wangihumushela isiqephu, futhi wangitshengisa lezi zinkanyezi."

Imibuzo:
UNosisa uthanda izinkanyezi na?
Kunjalo, uthanda izinkanyezi kakhulu.
Ibhuku likaNosisa libhalwe ngesiZulu na?
Cha, libhalwe ngesiNgisi.
UZwelethu uhumushela uNosisa isiqephu sebhuku na?
Kunjalo, ufunda isiqephu ngesiNgisi, bese ehumusha.
UZwelethu ukhomba izinkanyezi ngomunwe na?
Kunjalo, umtshengisa izinkanyezi ezintathu.
UNosisa usebenzisa ikhompyutha yesikole na?
Kunjalo, ufuna izithombe zezinkanyezi ekhompyutheni.

lessons.title: Indlala eMahlabathini
lessons.summary: In a year without rain, old farmer Mzokhona's livestock have no grass and famine comes to Mahlabathini; Fikile of the welfare department calls for ubuntu, a rich farmer lends his pond's water and his lorry, the people vote to share it and work hard until the rain returns.
lessons.text:
UMzokhona ungumlimi omdala eMahlabathini. Unemfuyo eningi: izinkomo nezimbuzi. Imfuyo yakhe iyingcebo yakhe. Kodwa kulo nyaka akukho mvula. Umhlabathi womile. Utshani bomile.

Imfuyo iswele utshani namanzi. Izinkomo azinawo amandla. Ezinye izimbuzi ziyafa. Nabantu baswele ukudla. Indlala ifikile esigodini. UMzokhona uthi: "Indlala inkulu kakhulu kulo nyaka. Imfuyo yethu iswele utshani, nathi siswele ukudla."

Umphakathi uba nomhlangano esikoleni. UFikile uyafika emhlanganweni. Usebenza eMnyangweni wezenhlalakahle. Uthi: "Umnyango wezenhlalakahle uzoninika ukudla izinyanga ezintathu. Kodwa kufuneka nibe nobuntu. Kufuneka nisizane."

Eduze nesigodi kukhona umlimi onengcebo enkulu. Unechibi elikhulu elinamanzi amaningi. Uthi emhlanganweni: "Ngizoboleka umphakathi amanzi echibi lami. Ngizoboleka umphakathi neloli lami lokuthwala amanzi."

UFikile uthi: "Masenze ivoti. Ngubani ofuna ukuthi imindeni yonke yabelane ngamanzi?" Abantu bafaka amavoti abo. Amavoti amaningi athi yebo. Bonke bayavuma.

Ngakusasa abantu basebenza ngokuqinisa. Abesilisa bathwala amanzi ngeloli. Abesifazane banika imfuyo amanzi. Izingane zisiza ngokuqinisa. UMzokhona uthi: "Lobu ngubuntu. Umuntu ngumuntu ngabantu."

Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbili imvula iyana. Utshani buyakhula futhi. Imfuyo iyadla. Indlala iyaphela kancane. UMzokhona uya kumlimi onengcebo. Uthi: "Ngiyakubonga ngokusiboleka amanzi neloli lakho. Ingcebo yakho isisizile." Umlimi uthi: "Ingcebo yami iyingcebo yomphakathi."

Imibuzo:
Kulo nyaka kukhona imvula eMahlabathini na?
Cha, akukho mvula, futhi utshani bomile.
Imfuyo kaMzokhona iswele utshani na?
Kunjalo, iswele utshani namanzi.
UFikile usebenza eMnyangweni wezenhlalakahle na?
Kunjalo, usebenza eMnyangweni wezenhlalakahle.
Umlimi onengcebo uboleka umphakathi amanzi na?
Kunjalo, uboleka amanzi neloli lakhe.
Amavoti amaningi athi yebo na?
Kunjalo, amavoti amaningi athi yebo.

lessons.title: UDisemba ekhaya
lessons.summary: On the last day of a hot December in Durban, Ntombifuthi and her son Nduduzo invite the family, cook meat, rice and garden vegetables, lay a table under a tree with cold milk, sing old hymns and make promises for January.
lessons.text:
UNtombifuthi uhlala eThekwini nendodana yakhe, uNduduzo. NgoDisemba isikole sivaliwe, futhi kuyashisa kakhulu eThekwini. Ngalo nyaka uNtombifuthi ufuna ukugubha ukuphela konyaka nomndeni wakhe wonke.

UNtombifuthi umema abazali bakhe. Umema nezihlobo zakhe nezingane zazo. Uthi ocingweni: "Ngiyanimema nonke. Sizogubha ndawonye ngoDisemba, ngosuku lokugcina lonyaka."

Ngosuku lokugcina lukaDisemba uNtombifuthi noNduduzo bavuka ekuseni. Baya ensimini yabo encane. Ensimini kunemifino eminingi: amazambane nemifino eluhlaza. UNduduzo uthatha imifino. Unina uthi: "Imifino yethu mihle kulo nyaka."

UNtombifuthi upheka inyama nelayisi. Upheka nemifino. UNduduzo usiza unina ukupheka. Ngemuva kokupheka babeka itafula elikhulu egcekeni, phansi kwesihlahla. Ilanga liyashisa, kodwa phansi kwesihlahla akushisi kakhulu. Babeka ukudla etafuleni. Babeka nebhodlela lobisi olubandayo etafuleni.

Emini umndeni uyafika. Bonke bahlala ngasetafuleni. Badla ukudla okumnandi. Izingane ziphuza ubisi olubandayo. Ugogo uthi: "Masicule iculo lakudala." Ugogo uqala iculo, bese bonke becula. Bacula iculo ngemuva kwelinye.

Kusihlwa uNtombifuthi uthi: "NgoJanuwari kuqala unyaka omusha. Masenze izithembiso. Umuntu ngamunye makenze isithembiso esisodwa." Ugogo uthi: "Isithembiso sami: ngizonivakashela kaningi." UNduduzo uthi: "Isithembiso sami: ngoJanuwari ngizofunda kakhulu esikoleni."

Bonke bayahleka, bashaye izandla. UNtombifuthi uthi: "Ngiyanibonga ukuthi nize nonke. Sigubhe kahle kakhulu." Abantu bacula iculo lokugcina, bese bebuyela emakhaya abo.

Imibuzo:
UNtombifuthi ufuna ukugubha ukuphela konyaka na?
Kunjalo, ufuna ukugubha nomndeni wakhe wonke.
UNtombifuthi umema abazali bakhe na?
Kunjalo, umema abazali bakhe nezihlobo zakhe.
UNtombifuthi upheka imifino yasensimini na?
Kunjalo, upheka inyama, ilayisi nemifino.
Izingane ziphuza ubisi olubandayo na?
Kunjalo, ziphuza ubisi olubandayo.
UNduduzo wenza isithembiso na?
Kunjalo, uthi ngoJanuwari uzofunda kakhulu esikoleni.

lessons.title: Ugwayi kaVezi
lessons.summary: Old Vezi of Greytown promises his wife Jabulile to stop smoking but smokes in secret; in June his chest hurts and he is ill in bed, the doctor tells him to give up tobacco, he apologises, stops and heals.
lessons.text:
UVezi uyindoda endala. Uhlala eGreytown nomfazi wakhe, uJabulile. UVezi ubhema ugwayi iminyaka eminingi. UJabulile akakuthandi ukubhema kwakhe. Uthi: "Vezi, ugwayi uyakubulala. Yeka ukubhema."

UVezi uthi: "Kulungile. Ngizoyeka." UJabulile uyajabula. Kodwa uVezi akayeki. Ubhema ngemfihlo. Ekuseni uhamba ngemuva kwendlu, abheme ugwayi. Ukubhema kwakhe kuyimfihlo. UJabulile akayazi le mfihlo.

NgoJuni kuyabanda kakhulu eGreytown. UVezi uyagula. Isifuba sakhe sibuhlungu. Ukhwehlela ebusuku. Akakwazi ukulala kahle. Ukugula kwakhe kukhula usuku ngalunye. Ekugcineni akakwazi ukuvuka embhedeni. Ulala embhedeni izinsuku ezimbili.

UJabulile uhamba naye kudokotela. Udokotela uhlola isifuba sakhe. Uthi: "Isifuba sakho sibuhlungu ngenxa yogwayi. Uyabhema na?" UVezi uthula isikhashana. Bese uthi: "Yebo, dokotela. Ngiyabhema." Udokotela uthi: "Ukugula kwakho kuvela ogwayini. Kufuneka uyeke ugwayi. Zila ugwayi! Uma uwuzila, isifuba sakho sizophola."

UJabulile uyathukuthela. Uthi: "Vezi! Wawuthi uyekile ukubhema!" UVezi uthi: "Ngiyaxolisa, Jabulile. Ngibhema ngemfihlo ngemuva kwendlu. Ngiyaxolisa kakhulu."

UVezi ubuyela ekhaya. Ulala embhedeni futhi. UJabulile umenzela ukudla okushisayo. Kusukela ngalolo suku uVezi uzila ugwayi. Ugwayi wakhe uwulahla. Akabhemi futhi.

Ngemuva kwesonto isifuba sakhe siyaphola. Akalali embhedeni usuku lonke. Uyavuka, ahambe kancane egcekeni. UJabulile uthi: "Uyaphola, Vezi. Ngiyajabula." Ngemuva kwenyanga uphole ngokuphelele. UVezi uthi: "Jabulile, ngiyakubonga. Ngiyakuthembisa: ngizozila ugwayi impilo yami yonke." UJabulile uyajabula.

Imibuzo:
UVezi ubhema ugwayi na?
Kunjalo, ubhema ugwayi iminyaka eminingi.
UVezi ubhema ngemfihlo na?
Kunjalo, ukubhema kwakhe kuyimfihlo.
Isifuba sikaVezi sibuhlungu na?
Kunjalo, isifuba sakhe sibuhlungu ngenxa yogwayi.
UVezi uyaxolisa kuJabulile na?
Kunjalo, uthi: "Ngiyaxolisa kakhulu."
Isifuba sikaVezi siyaphola na?
Kunjalo, ngemuva kwenyanga uphole ngokuphelele.

lessons.title: Ihhashi likaZwelakhe
lessons.summary: Cart maker Zwelakhe near Nkandla buys a young, wild horse that jumps the wall and eats his neighbour Nonkululeko's vegetables; she refuses his money and wants a fence, so he orders wire, brings the horse in every evening, and it grows tame.
lessons.text:
UZwelakhe uhlala esigodini eduze neNkandla. Ungumenzi wezinqola. Wenza izinqola ngokhuni nangensimbi. Abantu abaningi bathenga izinqola zakhe, ngoba ungumenzi omuhle.

NgoMashi uZwelakhe uthenga ihhashi elisha elincane. Ufuna ukuthi ihhashi lidonse inqola yakhe. Kodwa ihhashi alithambile. Ligijima yonke indawo. Alifuni ukudonsa inqola.

Ngolunye usuku ihhashi leqa udonga. Lingena ensimini kamakhelwane, uNonkululeko. Lidla imifino yakhe yonke. UNonkululeko uyathukuthela kakhulu. Uthi: "Ngiyalizonda leli hhashi!" Uya kuZwelakhe. Kuba nengxabano enkulu phakathi kwabo.

Uthi kuZwelakhe: "Ihhashi lakho lidle imifino yami yonke!" UZwelakhe uthi: "Ngiyaxolisa. Ngizokukhokhela imifino yakho." Kodwa uNonkululeko uyanqaba. Uthi: "Anginqabi ukuxolisa kwakho, kodwa imali yakho angiyifuni. Oda ucingo, wenze uthango oluqinile."

Ukuphawula kukaNonkululeko kuyamthinta uZwelakhe. Ngakho uthi kumfazi wakhe: "UNonkululeko uthi kufuneka sibe nothango oluqinile." Umfazi wakhe uthi: "Kunjalo. Oda ucingo olusha edolobheni." UZwelakhe uthenga ucingo olusha esitolo sasedolobheni. Ngemuva kwesonto ucingo luyafika ngeloli.

UZwelakhe wenza uthango olusha oluqinile ngocingo. Kusihlwa ungenisa ihhashi egcekeni. Usuku ngalunye ulingenisa egcekeni ngaphambi kokuthi kuhlwe. Ukhuluma nalo kahle. Uyalinika utshani namanzi.

Kancane kancane ihhashi liyathamba. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbili lithambile ngempela. Lidonsa inqola kahle. Aliphindi lidle imifino kaNonkululeko.

Ngolunye usuku uNonkululeko ubona uZwelakhe nehhashi nenqola. Uthi: "Leli hhashi lithambile manje. Manje angilizondi. Akusekho ngxabano phakathi kwethu." Lokhu kungukuphawula okumnandi. UZwelakhe uyajabula. Uthi: "Ngiyakubonga. Ngizokwenzela inqola encane yokuthwala imifino yakho." UNonkululeko akanqabi.

Imibuzo:
UZwelakhe ungumenzi wezinqola na?
Kunjalo, wenza izinqola ngokhuni nangensimbi.
Ihhashi lingena ensimini kaNonkululeko na?
Kunjalo, leqa udonga, lidle imifino yakhe.
UNonkululeko uyayamukela imali kaZwelakhe na?
Cha, uyanqaba imali. Ufuna uthango oluqinile.
UZwelakhe ungenisa ihhashi egcekeni kusihlwa na?
Kunjalo, ulingenisa usuku ngalunye ngaphambi kokuthi kuhlwe.
Ihhashi liyathamba na?
Kunjalo, ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbili lithambile ngempela.

lessons.title: Udaka lwasenqabeni
lessons.summary: In March schoolgirl Mbalenhle of Eshowe must analyse soil for her teacher Msizi; she walks to the old fort, takes hard red clay, studies it in a bottle of water, moulds nine small pots and passes with nine out of ten.
lessons.text:
UMbalenhle ufunda esikoleni eShowe. Umfundisi wakhe nguMsizi. NgoMashi uMsizi uthi ekilasini: "NgoMashi ihlobo liyaphela. Kuvamise ukuthi imvula ibe ncane ngoMashi. Kuvamise nokuthi umhlabathi ube lukhuni. Ngifuna nicubungule umhlabathi wendawo ethile, nibhale umbiko."

UMbalenhle ukhumbula inqaba endala eShowe. Inqaba isentabeni encane. Yakhiwa kudala ngamatshe. UMbalenhle uthi: "Ngizocubungula umhlabathi wasenqabeni." NgoMgqibelo uhamba aye enqabeni.

Indlela eya enqabeni inde. Ilanga liyashisa. Imilenze kaMbalenhle iyakhathala. Umlenze wakhe owodwa ubuhlungu kancane. Kodwa uyaqhubeka. Ekugcineni ufika enqabeni.

Eduze nenqaba umhlabathi ulukhuni kakhulu. UMbalenhle uthatha induku, ashaye umhlabathi olukhuni. Ngaphansi kwawo uthola udaka olubomvu. Ulufaka esikhwameni sakhe.

Ekhaya uMbalenhle ucubungula udaka. Ulufaka ebhodleleni elinamanzi. Unyakazisa ibhodlela, bese elinda ihora lonke. Amatshe amancane ayehla phansi. Udaka olubomvu luhlala phezulu. UMbalenhle ubhala konke akubonayo embikweni wakhe.

Ngakusasa uMbalenhle uthatha udaka olubomvu. Ubumba izitsha ezincane ngodaka. Ubumba isitsha ngesitsha. Ekugcineni unezitsha eziyisishiyagalolunye. Uzibeka elangeni. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbili izitsha zilukhuni.

NgoMsombuluko uMbalenhle uletha umbiko wakhe nezitsha eziyisishiyagalolunye ekilasini. UMsizi ufunda umbiko. Ubheka izitsha. Uthi: "Mbalenhle, ucubungule umhlabathi kahle kakhulu. Futhi ubumbe izitsha ezinhle." Abafundi bayamncoma uMbalenhle.

Ngemuva kwesonto uMsizi unika abafundi amaphuzu abo. UMbalenhle uphasile kahle kakhulu. Uthola amaphuzu ayisishiyagalolunye. Amaphuzu aphezulu ayishumi. Abanye abafundi nabo baphasile. UMbalenhle uthi: "Inqaba endala ingisizile ukuthi ngiphase."

Imibuzo:
NgoMashi kuvamise ukuthi umhlabathi ube lukhuni na?
Kunjalo, kuvamise ukuthi umhlabathi ube lukhuni.
UMbalenhle uhamba aye enqabeni endala na?
Kunjalo, uhamba aye enqabeni eShowe.
Imilenze kaMbalenhle iyakhathala na?
Kunjalo, umlenze wakhe owodwa ubuhlungu kancane.
UMbalenhle ubumba izitsha ngodaka na?
Kunjalo, ubumba izitsha eziyisishiyagalolunye.
UMbalenhle uphasile na?
Kunjalo, uthola amaphuzu ayisishiyagalolunye.
